purpose: An input-styled button that opens the date picker without leaving the form, showing the calendar glyph and either the placeholder or the chosen date.

notFor.case: A date panel that is always visible on the page.
A known date, such as a birthday, typed faster than picked.
Picking from a list of options that are not dates.

Default.visual: Surface/input box with a Border/control edge; glyph and placeholder in Content/subtle, date in Content/primary.

Focused.visual: Border/focus edge with a Border/ring/default halo.

Disabled.visual: Surface/muted fill; glyph, date and placeholder in Content/disabled.

Loading.visual: The Default look with a spinner in Content/subtle in place of the glyph.

a11y.role: button with aria-haspopup="dialog", opening a non-modal Radix Popover
a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Space or Enter opens and closes the picker; Escape closes it and returns focus here.
notes: Its text is the chosen date, so no separate label is read; pair it with a Label (Field).
The edge moves with use-hover and the halo with use-focus.

openQuestions: Date colour: Figma paints the date text Content/subtle in 15 variants, the contract uses Content/primary. Which is right? (finding PAR-001 DatePickerTrigger text.text)
Invalid: Figma draws no halo on Invalid, unlike Input. Intended?
Accessible name: when a date is chosen the button reads only the date. Should the field's label also be part of its name (aria-labelledby)?
Reduced motion: should the edge and halo transitions (use-hover, use-focus) be instant with reduced motion?
